instruction: Choose a suitable tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD to complete the task. Use the selected tool to complete a nonlinear Static Structural contact analysis. Physical problem: An elastic steel sphere presses against an elastic steel plate through frictionless contact. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - Use a full 3D model. - The vertical loading direction is the negative global Y direction. - The plate is centered about the global origin in the X-Z plane. - The plate dimensions are: - X direction: 100 mm - Z direction: 100 mm - Y direction thickness: 10 mm - Place the plate so that: - The top surface is at Y = 0 mm - The bottom surface is at Y = -10 mm - The sphere radius is 10 mm. - Place the sphere above the plate with its center on the global Y axis. - The lower point of the sphere should initially contact the center of the plate top surface. Model parameters: - Sphere material: Structural Steel - Plate material: Structural Steel - Use the following linear elastic properties for both bodies: - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3 - Mesh: - Use local refinement in the contact region. - Local element size in the contact region: 0.3 mm - Element size away from the contact region: 2 mm Contact setup: - Contact pair: sphere surface against the top surface of the plate. - Contact type: Frictionless. - Contact formulation: Augmented Lagrange or Pure Penalty. - Use appropriate normal contact stiffness settings to obtain a converged nonlinear contact solution. Boundary conditions and load: - Fix the bottom face of the plate. - Apply a vertical compressive force of 500 N to the sphere in the negative global Y direction. - Prevent only the unnecessary rigid-body lateral motion of the sphere, while allowing the sphere to move vertically into contact with the plate. - Do not fully fix the sphere. Analysis type: - Nonlinear Static Structural analysis. - Enable large deflection. - Use automatic time stepping or sufficient load substeps to obtain a converged contact solution. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and native solver result artifact on the Desktop. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
